newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB details primary elevator space, railcar unload.
newsitem.headline: CWB details primary elevator space, railcar unload.

text.p: Vacant space in Prairie elevators increase to 28 percent in the week ended December 22, up from 26 percent the week before, the Canadian Wheat Board said.
Alberta elevators had the most space available at 30 percent vacant, compared to 31 percent the prior week.
Saskatchewan elevators had 28 percent space available compared to 24 percent the previous week.
Manitoba had 26 percent of space available, up from 25 percent the week before.
Railcar unloads exceeded targets at Thunder Bay.
Thunder Bay saw 1,946 railcar unloads compared to the target of 1,815 for the week ended December 22.
Railcar unloads at Vancouver reached 2,326, below the 3,400 target and unloads at Prince Rupert totalled 1,199 compared to the target of 1,500.
